Backend: 8/8 new tests pass (KPIs Net Profit=net_after_ads, missing-sku-costs response shape + xlsx export, TIER1_MIN_PAGES=5, /runs & /recent-runs expose tier1_pages/tier2_pages, /runs/{id}/unmatched.xlsx works). Existing pdf_sorter_iter6 tier1+tier2==master test still passes. Frontend: FIX 1 (Expand/Collapse All on /pl/sku-analysis) works — Collapse hides all account nodes (0), Expand reveals all 5. FIX 4d: Master Print button shows count badge but Tier 1/Tier 2 buttons DO NOT render badges even though DB has tier2_pages=3 — bug is that /analytics `latest_run` payload and the inline `runResult`→run transform in PrintoutLabelsPage.js (line 697-704) both drop the tier1_pages/tier2_pages fields.

ui_bugs.issue: Tier 1 · High Volume and Tier 2 · Low Volume buttons never show a page-count badge. Confirmed via DB: run RUN_20260821_145949 has tier2_pages=3, yet the UI shows only 'Tier 2 · Low Volume' with no [3] badge. Two root causes: (1) /api/pdf-sorter/analytics `latest_run` construction (routers/pdf_sorter.py ~lines 268-283) does not include tier1_pages/tier2_pages, (2) in PrintoutLabelsPage.js the inline transform at lines 697-704 (when runResult exists) also omits tier1_pages/tier2_pages when building the `run` prop passed to LastRunDownloads. Master Print badge works because it uses run.total_pages.

action_items: Fix FIX 4d: In /app/backend/routers/pdf_sorter.py `analytics()` (around line 268), add tier1_pages / tier2_pages (and ideally tier1_categories/tier2_categories) to the latest_run dict. Also in /app/frontend/src/pages/pl/../PrintoutLabelsPage.js line 697-704, propagate runResult.tier1_pages / runResult.tier2_pages when constructing the run prop. After the fix, tier2_pages=3 for the existing seeded run should surface a '3' badge next to 'Tier 2 · Low Volume'.
critical_code_review_comments: PrintoutLabelsPage.js LastRunDownloads.tierCounts uses run.tier1_pages ?? 0 — silently falls back to 0 when field missing; would benefit from a console.warn or a visual indicator if missing to catch the current bug earlier.

REV·PROFIT / NET PROFIT chips in AggBadges only render when agg.units_ordered>0; consider showing them with ₹0 in preview/empty state so E1 users can visually confirm renaming took effect (currently every row shows 'no data' → renaming is invisible to non-devs).

/api/pl/missing-sku-costs/export returns correct XLSX headers; response filename prefix `missing_sku_costs_` verified.
